checkpoint_policy_proposal: Endpoint-only campaign: save no intermediate training checkpoints, only final model and trainer logs/state. This changes storage schedule only, not optimizer updates. Requires explicit implementation and source audit before training; not implemented yet.
interruption_limitation: Without resumable optimizer checkpoint, an interrupted training cannot be silently replayed; record blocker, preserve evidence, follow bounded continuation rules.
cumulative_gate: Recheck before every run; do not assume five final artifacts fit. If protected artifact deletion becomes necessary, STOP and request exact-path approval.
